Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Organic Growth Analyst position. With a strong foundation in SEO, content strategy, and analytics, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to data-driven organic growth for B2B software clients.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, conduct keyword research, and build WordPress sites. I use tools like Google Analytics, Ahrefs, and SEMrush to track performance and inform decisions. My personal project, mirook.com, has allowed me to implement structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits, improving visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

I am analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. I am comfortable working independently in a remote environment and can overlap with Eastern Time hours. I am drawn to this role's focus on professional growth and the opportunity to develop into a strategist.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills align with your team's needs. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Organic Growth Analyst position. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and analytics, I am eager to support data-driven organic growth initiatives for B2B software clients.

In my current role at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing. I write keyword-targeted blog content and build/maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I regularly use Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and guide decisions. This experience has taught me how to translate data into actionable insights that improve organic visibility and drive measurable outcomes.

My personal project, mirook.com, has been a sandbox for advanced SEO and GEO techniques. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines. I also ran iterative technical audits, measurably improving the site's search-health score. This project demonstrates my curiosity and commitment to staying ahead of industry trends.

I am highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks while maintaining quality. I thrive in remote, high-performance environments and can overlap with Eastern Time hours. I am eager to learn from experienced strategists and contribute to internal brainstorming and innovation projects.

I am particularly drawn to this role's clear career progression toward an Organic Growth Strategist position. I am confident that my skills and enthusiasm make me a strong fit. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
